name: Dry Bean Dataset
description: The Dry Bean dataset consists of 13,611 grains of 7 different registered dry bean varieties (Seker, Barbunya, Bombay, Cali, Dermason, Horoz, Sira) captured with a high-resolution camera. 16 dimensional morphological and shape features were extracted from each bean image for computer vision classification.
